tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search the public pages and research notes on excessionlabs.ai. Returns titles, URLs and one-line summaries.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Read one public page of excessionlabs.ai as Markdown. Use a path from search_site or llms.txt.

tools.name: how_to_contact
tools.description: Return the ways a person can contact Excession Labs: the request form, email, and the request_security_test tool for agents.

tools.name: request_security_test
tools.description: Send a request for a security test (web application, API, multi-tenant SaaS isolation or AI application) to Excession Labs on behalf of a person who asked for it. Needs an agent key (POST https://excessionlabs.ai/agent/auth, then Authorization: Bearer <key>). Excession Labs replies to the person by

tools.name: cve_search
tools.description: Search the hosted Excession Labs CVE database. Choose recent modification, new publication, or known-exploitation priority. Software/version filters match source assertions; they do not evaluate whether an installation is affected.

tools.name: cve_get
tools.description: Read a CVE's descriptions, severity, affected software/version evidence, source references, KEV and EPSS. Large affected-software lists are paginated; inspect the returned cursor and completeness fields.

tools.name: cve_history
tools.description: Read normalized source revisions retained after hosted monitoring starts. Version claims can refer to shared affected_groups by group_id. Initial hosted observations establish a baseline; the initial snapshot is not a complete historical archive. Inspect returned coverage and pagination.

tools.name: cve_status
tools.description: Read corpus counts, source coverage, collection errors, freshness and saved update checkpoints. A successful bounded query does not imply complete upstream coverage.

tools.name: cve_sources
tools.description: Read the hosted source catalog, attribution, update methods and coverage limits.

tools.name: cve_changes
tools.description: Read hosted changes after a saved sequence cursor. Process the page before resuming with next_after. This is a read-only feed; it does not create a notification subscription.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "request_security_test" references sensitive artifacts (password, authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Send a request for a security test (web application, API, multi-tenant SaaS isolation or AI application) to Excession Labs on behalf of a person who asked for i…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_site, cve_changes · Private data: how_to_contact, request_security_test, cve_search · Public sink: how_to_contact, request_security_test.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_site, cve_changes · Private data: how_to_contact, request_security_test, cve_search · Public sink: how_to_contact, request_security_test

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
